everyExternalService.nextAction: Keep Firebase public config declared; runtime auth verification remains separate.
Use runtime diagnostics for Firestore connectivity; package presence is inventory only.
Keep admin credentials secret and classify runtime separately.
Keep storage config separate from entitlement and egress runtime checks.
Functions package declares runtime; deployed functions health requires separate evidence.
Hosting config exists in firebase.json; deployment status remains external evidence.
Database rules/config are inventoried; runtime use must be proven separately.
Push config missing is actionable only for push surfaces; do not infer notification delivery health.
GA Data API stays explicit refresh evidence and must not run in validators.
GA4 config is external evidence only and does not replace first-party telemetry.
BigQuery export is evidence/export only and requires bounded jobs.
Data Connect remains an agent/retrieval mirror unless explicitly promoted.
Cloud hosting runtime is external infrastructure evidence, not package health.
AI provider calls must remain budgeted and disabled in validators.
PayPal config presence does not prove payment runtime; payment runtime is protected.
PostHog remains consent/config gated and external evidence only.
PWA/service worker source checks are separate from package inventory.
Scheduler runtime requires heartbeat/dispatch evidence, not package presence.
No active email/SMS provider is required unless a future provider is explicitly enabled.

expectedAbsentDependencies.name: @google-cloud/pubsub
expectedAbsentDependencies.reason: Queue runtime uses Firestore-backed dispatch outcomes; Pub/Sub is not a direct dependency.

expectedAbsentDependencies.reason: Storage is provided through Firebase SDK/Admin transitive dependency unless promoted directly.

expectedAbsentDependencies.reason: SMTP config is optional/future and no package is expected.

runtimeCopy: Package presence does not prove runtime use. Firestore connectivity and telemetry ping are separate runtime checks.
